005package org.wpilib.util;
006
007/** Exception thrown to indicate an alert condition with an associated reason code. */
008public class AlertException extends RuntimeException {
009  private static final long serialVersionUID = -4273483424L;
010
011  /** The reason code associated with this exception. */
012  private final int reason;
013
014  /**
015   * Constructs a new AlertException with the specified detail message and reason code.
016   *
017   * @param message the detail message
018   * @param reason the reason code associated with this exception
019   */
020  public AlertException(String message, int reason) {
021    super(message);
022    this.reason = reason;
023  }
024
025  /**
026   * Gets the reason code associated with this exception.
027   *
028   * @return the reason code
029   */
030  public int getReason() {
031    return reason;
032  }
033}
